summary: Backend-only regression testing completed for Music League app. All 20 tests passed including new chat endpoints and zero-point user visibility tests. Covers: Auth (4), League (2), Round (1), Voting System (4 - N-1 points, non-voter distribution, ties), Standings (1), User Stats (1), Non-Submitter (1), Chat Endpoints (4 - send/get messages, empty content validation, chat status), Zero-Point Users (2 - single and multi-round).
critical_code_review_comments: Chat status endpoint correctly tracks unread messages for each user
Empty/whitespace-only messages correctly rejected with 400 status
Zero-point users (members who never submitted) correctly appear in standings with 0 pts, 0 wins, 0 rounds_played
N-1 voting point system regression tests all passing
Tie handling verified: same points = same rank, is_tie flag set, multiple winners listed
seed_data_creation: Test users created with TEST_ prefix for each test class
